scope: Shared CSV Trends period and scrolling fix; frontend only

behavior.controls: Sidebar/mobile filter sheet: shared year range plus final month
behavior.population: Uses the same final month and same-year denominator; monthly rows stop at cutoff
behavior.presentation: Ranking sort remains local; geographic source retains its independent controls

scroll.cause: Absolutely positioned screen-reader captions escaped an unpositioned scroll container and expanded the desktop document
scroll.fix: Position Trends scroll container relative; preserve accessible captions and native compact-layout page scrolling
scroll.regression: Desktop browser test failed on the preceding build and passed after the CSS fix

requirementEvidence.sharedDateState: sharedTrendPeriod tests; App.test.tsx: defaults to Map and preserves geographic filters when switching to Trends and back
requirementEvidence.monthCutoff: PopulationComparison.test.tsx: limits monthly rows to the shared closing month
requirementEvidence.mobileSynchronization: population comparison preserves counts, filters and source separation
requirementEvidence.scrollRegression: trend scrolling stays within its panel without a blank document tail

skills.shadcn: Inspected project configuration and slider/field documentation; reused installed Base UI slider and native accessible controls
skills.react: Derived one shared period rather than duplicate local state; cancellation and scalar request keys retained
skills.webGuidelines: Grouped controls, accessible labels/help text, scroll containment, mobile overflow checked
skills.viewTransitions: Audited React 19.3 support and patterns; shared persistent controls/background data refresh do not require navigation or list animations

runtime: Local web container rebuilt and running at http://localhost:5173/tendencias
